checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicitly disclosed and remains eligible for content review; all derived geometry and metrics require recalculation when official polygons arrive.
Three required key areas remain provisional, non-overlapping and inside the site; no official-boundary claim is made.
Design layers use valid EPSG:4326 GeoJSON and permitted layer/source/confidence/role fields.
Sequential difference polygons cover the submitted site with no material gap or overlap in EPSG:4548.
Site area, green ratio and public-space ratio are derived from the same submitted geometry; legal controls and outcome metrics remain unknown.
All twelve scenarios identify human fallback, appeal, stop and rollback; the AI agent is never Accountable.
Offline display contains required sections and exact metric markers without remote or active content.
All standards, depth items, sources, known metrics and nine geometry layers have machine-readable references.
All eight A3 pages and three A0 boards were rendered with macOS PDFKit and visually inspected; no blank page, clipping, overlap or unreadable CJK text was found.
Rights ledger distinguishes original assets, public factual sources and provisional repository constraints; no external visual asset is used.
Readable HTML and visual HTML contain no script, network call, iframe, form or tracking resource.
